newsitem.title: USA: IES shareholder vote on merger certified.
newsitem.headline: IES shareholder vote on merger certified.

text.p: IES Industries Inc said Thursday that its inspector of elections officially certified that shareholders voted in favor of the company's merger with WPL Holdings Inc and Interstate Power Co.

CT Company, the inspector, said the final tabulation of proxies received at the IES annual meeting September 5 showed 16.2 million out of 29.9 million shares, or about 54.3 percent, favored the transaction.
The three companies expect to complete the merger during the first half of 1997.

On November 11, 1995, IES, WPL Holdings and Interstate Power announced their intention to combine as Interstate Energy Corp. The new company will serve more than 870,000 electric customers and more than 360,000 natural gas customers in Iowa, Wisconsin, Illinois and Minnesota.
